label: Divine willing of creaturely esse supports the CREATURE_WILLING_1 bridge
note: The corpus supplies the esse instance of velle bonum alicui used by this application, with causation through divine will as its basis in q.19 a.4. The separate GOOD_4 definition gives the general account across perfections. The model's antecedent has generic CausesIn plus HasWill, so the bridge still needs causation through will and recipient-directed willing consistent with ordered quasi-desire in ad 3.
